verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Adyen pays out to global sellers. Managed payout schedules apply to balance accounts sharing a location and currency, which implies local-currency balances and payouts. 'Most efficient payout logic' hints at rail selection but never states that local bank rails are used instead of wires. Missing for 10: documented FX conversion handling and rates, explicit local bank rail settlement (vs. wires), explicit per-country local-currency payout coverage, independent corroboration.
